title: Spectre Brands · Post-mortems of dead and ghost brands
description: Sourced, illustrated post-mortems of companies and brands that died, or live on only as a name: Pets.com, Webvan, RadioShack and more.
headline: Every brand dies twice: once when the money runs out, and again when people forget it.
intro: Spectre Brands writes the second obituary. Each post-mortem rebuilds a company from its SEC filings, contemporary press and archived web pages, with charts you can check, a map and timeline you can scrub, and original drawings of what the brand looked like.
soon: Restaurant chains, film studios and game makers are in research. Each category opens with its first post-mortem.

categories.label: Restaurants
categories.blurb: Chains that closed their last location, or survive as one.

method: Every figure links to a numbered source: SEC filings first, then contemporary press, then the archive.
Numbers we calculate are labeled **derived**. Claims we couldn't confirm are labeled **unverified**, or left out.
Old websites are shown as screenshots of Internet Archive captures, each linked to the original capture.
Logos and ads appear in historical and editorial context. Drawings are original recreations, not official assets.
Cause-of-death weights and what-if scenarios are editorial judgment and are marked as such.
schema: **Core:** Overview, Story, Timeline, The numbers, Cause of death, What if, Afterlife, Sources.
**Optional modules:** Context, Map (with a linked timeline), Unit economics, Marketing, Rivals, Old website, Brand gallery, People, Press.
The section menu on each page lists only the sections that page has.
